title: <component>.json
description: A component's record, read by rbtv.

description.description: One line that is enough to decide whether the component is relevant.

dependencies.description: Outside software the component requires but does not include.

repository.description: Optional git checkout. discovery.py loads this object; the checkout is not required to exist.

url.description: Git remote stored as origin. Must equal git remote get-url origin, including spelling. Must not start with -.

branch.description: Branch cloned and fast-forwarded. No spaces or leading dash.

requirements.description: Relative pip requirements path inside the checkout. No .. segment and no absolute path.
